task_context:
You are a Senior Code Reviewer reviewing a focused change. Work from /home/jpoimboe/imp.
## What to review
Task 3 of an implementation plan: add a journal-backed "Completed Changes" section to `imp status`.
- PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS: Task 3 in `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-06-01-live-test-worktree-slug-port.md`
The change replaces `_status_rows`/`_cmd_status` in `src/imp/cli/main.py` and adds `_status_row` (pure extractor), `_completed_rows` (journal-backed), `_STATUS_HEADER`, `_print_status_section`. Tests appended to `tests/test_journal_read_cli.py`. Context: `journal.journal_slugs(control) -> list[str]`, `journal.journal_show(control, slug, name) -> bytes | None`, and helpers `_last_event_timestamp`/`_journal_last_activity`/`_list_change_worktrees`/`_INFLIGHT` already exist.
## Your Job
Evaluate code quality of the diff only (don't flag pre-existing code outside the change). Consider:
- Correctness and edge cases: in-flight precedence vs journal overlap, KeyError risk in `_status_row` (`st["status"]`, `meta["title"]` on malformed/missing journal data), None handling, the empty/PreconditionError branch.
- Single responsibility / clean interfaces / independent testability of the new functions.
- Consistency with existing `_cmd_*`/helper patterns in main.py (read nearby code to judge — e.g. column widths, print style).
- Test quality: real behavior vs mocks; do they cover the precedence edge case meaningfully?
- Naming, clarity, maintainability, duplication.
- Did the change grow main.py problematically?
You may run `.venv/bin/pytest tests/test_journal_read_cli.py tests/test_cli_status.py tests/test_cli_smoke.py -q`, `make lint`, and `make typecheck` to confirm.
Return:
- **Strengths**
- **Issues** classified Critical / Important / Minor (file:line references)
- **Assessment**: Ready to merge? Yes/No
Note: the project gates on `make lint` AND `make typecheck` (not just tests) — a failure in either is at least an Important issue.

expected_findings.description: _status_row performs json.loads and key access without exception handling, risking crashes on malformed JSON or missing required keys in the journal.
The guard comment stating 'journaled rows are completed' is imprecise; should clarify that only completed rows are actually journaled and not errored rows.
Test asserts presence of values but does not verify they appear under the correct section headers (in-flight vs completed).
_print_status_section prints section titles even when rows is empty, resulting in verbose output when no Changes exist.
_completed_rows calls _journal_last_activity which spawns three separate git cat-file subprocess invocations per slug, potentially slow at scale.
